answer_1.quote: We train two BART models … the first takes as input character and location information and produces a short motivation … the second … produces the sequence of LIGHT game engine executable actions needed to achieve the motivation.
answer_1.outputs: short motivations, goal action sequences, dialogue utterances

answer_2.quote: We report the standard array of metrics: hits@10 and F1 ranking prediction score for retrieval models; and F1 (as a harmonic average of BLEU-1 and ROUGE-1) and perplexity for generative models.
